definitions.gloss: individual instruction; private tutoring; one-on-one guidance
definitions.explanation: Teaching or guidance tailored to an individual student, as opposed to group instruction. Very common in the Japanese education system, especially at cram schools.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend a cram school with individual instruction.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}なら⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペース→ペース：11173_peesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}べる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: With individual instruction, you can learn at your own pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{集中的|しゅうちゅうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ。
examples.english: For weak subjects, it is more effective to study intensively with individual tutoring.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in the Japanese education industry, especially in advertisements for ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ (cram schools). Many cram schools specifically brand themselves as {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ to distinguish from group-based instruction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ (individual tutoring cram school)
- {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive individual instruction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}{教師|きょうし}→家庭教師：09291_kateikyoushi⟧: private tutor — a person, not a system of instruction
- ⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: group instruction — the opposite approach
